label: Qualified dividends
description: Form 1040 (2025), line 3a: qualified dividends. Composes from Form 1099-DIV box 1b over the closed tax.us.2025.f1099div.1b family, gated on that family's closure only (ADR-0035 decisions 1-2, per-box closure independence).

published_value.explain: A current derived finding publishes this qualified-dividend amount; its lineage pins the box-1b subtotal.

computed_zero.explain: A current derived finding publishes a computed zero from present box-1b findings that sum to zero. The box-1b family is closed.

closure_backed_zero.explain: A current derived finding publishes a zero because the box-1b family is attested closed on its current horizon with no recorded members.

blocked.explain: Qualified dividends is blocked because the box-1b family is unclosed or its dependencies are missing.

guard_inapplicable.explain: No value exists because the rule guard is false.
